Maya (ML Ops): ok team — quick sync. we need a pragmatic rotation for seed assignments to reduce anchor bias for the new model bring-up. thinking weekly rotations + a tiny microholdout that moves with the seed. thoughts?

Samir (Curation): +1. how tiny? like 200 samples per labeler? we need enough to detect sudden labeler drift but not blow up throughput.

Leo (Quant): 200/week sounds OK for signal. also want to reserve 50 samples for the quantized-mode smoke evals (int4/int8) so we can cross-check behavioral deltas.

Ava (QA): SLA concern — labeler team is at 85% SLA on 48h right now. rotating weekly will cause ramp churn. can we stagger rotations so not everyone switches at once?

Maya (ML Ops): yes — staggered by labeler cohort. schedule plan: cohort A rotates Monday, cohort B Wednesday, cohort C Friday. microholdout moves with the cohort on rotation. that should smooth load.

Samir (Curation): agreed. also proposing an automated dedupe sweep every rotation boundary to avoid seed leakage. run: `python tools/dedupe.py --set $SEED --min-sim 0.92` (low cost pass).

Leo (Quant): add a second check: before a cohort goes live, run the small eval harness with the candidate quantized runtime and collect BLEU/ROUGE-ish metrics + embedding-sim deltas. script snippet: ```bash
./eval_harness --model candidate-q4b --set cohort_seed --out /tmp/seed_eval.json
jq '.metrics | {bleu,embed_delta}' /tmp/seed_eval.json
```

Ava (QA): +1 on gating. if embed_delta > 0.07 or fluency_drop > 0.05, send to manual review. can labeler-bot create alerts?

labeler-bot: created alert rule `seed_rotation_failures_v1` -> triggers slack @cxt if condition matches. linked to PagerDuty service curation-sla.

Maya (ML Ops): nice. on the SLA side: propose temporary soft-SLA of 72h for rotation weeks for the cohorts, with exceptions flagged automatically. Samir, can you run this with the label team?

Samir (Curation): will do. I'll message the label channel with the staggered schedule and the 72h soft-SLA. quick question: do we snapshot golden samples per rotation or keep a rolling golden?

Leo (Quant): snapshot per rotation. we need frozen references to track regressions across quant configs. keep snapshots in `gs://redwood-curation/goldshots/<rotation_ts>.ndjson` and a manifest `latest_symlink` for tools.

Ava (QA): one more ask — add a tiny canary of 20 adversarial-style prompts that exercise hallucination/contradiction. put them into the snapshot and run the hallucination check.

Maya (ML Ops): will add. I'll draft a rotation RFC and the runbook: - rotation cadence + cohorts - dedupe command - eval harness snippet - golden snapshot path - alert thresholds - SLA soft-exemption policy

Samir (Curation): thanks — once RFC is up I'll coordinate labeler leads for staggered dates.

Leo (Quant): timeline? can we start pilot next Monday for 2 cohorts?

Maya (ML Ops): pilot Monday. Samir, confirm labeler availability by EOD Friday and I'll post the RFC link in #eng-ml and #labeling.

labeler-bot: scheduled task `rotation-pilot` -> run at 2025-11-03T09:00:00Z (pilot start).

Ava (QA): noted. I'll prep the canary prompts and the automated checks.

Samir (Curation): pinged label leads. thanks all.
